name: biii
description: The real-world USDC till on Base — the Square/SumUp of USDC: an independent merchant accepts USDC in person with just a phone. Non-custodial (their own wallet), no terminal, no PSP, universal EIP-681 QR, field-for-field on-chain verification, receipt anchored to the tx.
